key.name: layout
key.summary: Order of the items in each box
key.description: Maps a box (left, center, right or status) to item ids in display order. Items missing from it stay where they are. Empty means the layout is not customized.

key.name: rules
key.description: Maps an item id to a rule: always, never, overview, desktop, hover, empty-workspace or windows. Items missing from it are always shown.

key.name: shortcuts
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut that toggles each item
key.description: Maps an item id to an accelerator such as <Super><Alt>1. Pressing it shows a hidden item or hides a shown one; pressing it again returns the item to its rule.

key.name: reveal-shortcut
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut that reveals every hidden item

key.name: reveal-timeout
key.summary: Seconds before revealed items hide again
key.description: 0 keeps them visible until the shortcut is pressed again.

key.name: hover-delay
key.summary: Milliseconds before "on hover" items hide after the pointer leaves the top bar

key.name: panel-mode
key.summary: When the whole top bar is shown
key.description: always: GNOME's default. never: hidden, shown only by the pointer, a menu or a shortcut. auto: hidden while any of panel-hide-when is true.

key.name: panel-hide-when
key.summary: Situations that hide the top bar in auto mode
key.description: Any of: overlap (a window touches the top bar), maximized (a window is maximized on its monitor), windows (the workspace has windows).

key.name: panel-show-in-overview
key.summary: Show the hidden top bar while the overview is open

key.name: panel-reveal-on-pressure
key.summary: Show the hidden top bar when the pointer pushes against the top edge

key.name: panel-shortcut
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut that shows or hides the top bar
key.description: Pressing it shows a hidden top bar or hides a shown one; pressing it again returns the top bar to panel-mode.

key.name: known-items
key.summary: Items found in the top bar (written by the extension)
key.description: Each entry is (id, box, label, icon), in display order. The preferences read it to list the items; changing it has no effect.
